title: Package boundary for the FPV core
goal: A framework-free TypeScript package folder that builds and tests on its own, in CI
acceptance: A package folder with its own package.json, tsconfig and exports, no Angular imports
A placeholder unit test runs in CI
Lint, format and conventions cover it
privacy: Battery test data is invented; no pilot or personal data.
escalation: A package layout or publishing choice that changes how NERV consumes the core goes to the owner first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed; implemented 2026-11-25: package folder src/fpv-core (own package.json, tsconfig, exports), placeholder test, lint/conventions purity guard, CI step. Verification pending: CI on the PR.
